title: Netflix Unveils Main Trailer and Release Date for 'The Gift of Deceit,' New Melodrama Starring Marieta Severo, Alice Wegmann, and Nanda Costta
summary: Netflix today unveiled the trailer for The Gift of Deceit, its new Brazilian melodrama series starring Marieta Severo, Alice Wegmann, and Nanda Costta. The 10-episode series set in Rio de Janeiro premieres October 28.
body_markdown:
São Paulo, September 30, 2026


- Get ready for the unexpected: in this story, nothing is quite what it seems. Netflix today unveiled the trailer for


The Gift of Deceit


, its new Brazilian melodrama series starring Marieta Severo, Alice Wegmann, and Nanda Costta. The 10-episode series set in Rio de Janeiro premieres October 28. Directed by Mauro Mendonça Filho, the show promises to keep audiences hooked with a gripping story of family intrigue, manipulation, and shocking twists.


Desperate to find a cure for the unknown illness afflicting her daughter, Maíra Rossetti (Alice Wegmann), art collector Lúcia Rossetti (Marieta Severo) turns to a spiritual therapist (Nanda Costta) for help. But when Lúcia becomes the victim of a scam, a web of secrets begins to unravel, exposing the deep ties between two families bound by love, control, resentment, and guilt.


The cast also includes big melodrama stars in the country: José de Abreu, Felipe Camargo, Luciana Paes, Laila Garin, Rui Ricardo Diaz, Heloisa Jorge, Allan Souza Lima, Jonas Bloch, Giovanna de Jesus, José Mata, Thiago Justino, Hamilton Dias, Laura Vick, Yanna Lavigne, and Rosanna Viegas.


The Gift of Deceit


is produced by Conspiração for Netflix, with Amaia serving as associate producer. The series was created by Diane Maia and Mirna Nogueira, who also serves as head writer alongside the team of writers Carol Rodrigues, Felipe Sholl, Josefina Trotta, and Pedro Riguetti. Renata Brandão and Luísa Barbosa serve as producers, with Diane Maia and Tania Pacheco as executive producers. Episodic direction is by Gabriela Amaral Almeida and Daniela Carvalho.


About Netflix


Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.


About Conspiração


Conspiração is one of Brazil’s leading independent production companies, founded by filmmakers and built around Brazilian artistic creation. With 10 International Emmy nominations – the most for any independent production company in Latin America – Conspiração co-produced


I'm Still Here


, winner of the Academy Award® for Best International Feature Film and the Golden Globe® for Best Actress – Drama. The production company is also behind five of the biggest box office hits in Brazilian cinema. Conspiração's projects have premiered at major international festivals, including Cannes, Berlin, Sundance, Venice and Toronto. With more than 50 feature films, 30 series and 45 documentaries produced, totaling more than 30 million tickets sold at the box office and over 300 awards, the company combines a strong artistic vision with projects that reach both Brazilian audiences and the international market, rooted in the strength of Brazilian storytelling.
